g.title: Long shot. A street at night, in the rain. Ken, left; Hana, right, pointing, looking at Ken. Caption: Shinjuku. Ten past midnight. Hana: You came. Ken: You called.
Medium close-up. A street at night, in the rain. Ken, centre. Ken, whispering: Is anybody else coming?
Close-up. A street at night, in the rain. Hana, centre. Hana: Only us.
Close-up. A street at night, in the rain. Ken, centre, surprised. Ken: Then why the umbrella?
Full shot. A street at night, in the rain. Ken, centre; Hana, centre. Sound effect: KRAK. Hana: Because it is raining. Ken: It always is, here.
Long shot. A street at night, in the rain. Ken, centre, sad. Caption: 00:10.
Medium shot. A street at night, in the rain. Hana, centre. Mother, off panel: Hana? Where are you? Hana: Nearly home.
Medium shot. A street at night, in the rain. Ken, centre, arms crossed. Ken: Go. I will wait.
